name: Mikak
description: Mikak was the first planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system.
lead_paragraphs: Mikak was the first planet orbiting the star Tyrius in the Tyrius system.
Located in the Savareen sector of the Outer Rim Territories, it was a tiny searing rock. Because of its proximity to its sun, it was unusable to the space-faring Rodians.
